tasks.description:
Define and document the core project team structure consisting of 4-5 people as specified in section 6.1 of the requirement specification. The team structure must include: 1 Product Manager, 1 Technical Lead, 2 Backend/CLI Developers, and 1 Quality Assurance professional.

This task establishes the foundational organizational framework for the project, ensuring all key roles are identified and documented. The team composition is designed to support MVP development of a CLI tool with Notion API integration.

Scope includes creating organizational documentation, defining reporting structure, and establishing communication channels between team members.
tasks.task_notes: This is a foundational organizational task that should be completed early in the project lifecycle. Consider how the team will be recruited, onboarded, and coordinated.

requirement_snippets:
### **6.1 Core Team Structure**
```
Project Team (4-5 people)
├── Product Manager (1)
├── Technical Lead (1)
├── Backend/CLI Developer (2)
└── Quality Assurance (1)
```
constraints: Team must consist of 4-5 people total
Each role must have the specified number of personnel
success_criteria: Team structure is documented with all 5 role categories
Team has exactly 1 Product Manager
Team has exactly 1 Technical Lead
Team has exactly 2 Backend/CLI Developers
Team has exactly 1 Quality Assurance professional

tasks.task_name: Define Product Manager role responsibilities and scope
tasks.description:
Document the Product Manager role as specified in section 6.2.1 of the requirement specification. The Product Manager is responsible for strategic and coordination activities including feature roadmap definition, user requirements gathering, stakeholder coordination, timeline management, business requirement validation, and documentation/marketing materials.

This task ensures the Product Manager role has clear accountability boundaries and deliverables. The responsibilities span business, strategic, and user-facing concerns, distinguishing this role from technical implementation roles.

The documentation should be detailed enough to support hiring, onboarding, and performance evaluation of the Product Manager.

responsibilities: Coordinate between stakeholders and development team

tasks.task_notes: This documentation should be created after the team structure is established. Consider using this as a basis for job descriptions, onboarding materials, and performance metrics.

requirement_snippets:
#### **6.2.1 Product Manager**
**Responsibilities:**
- Define and prioritize feature roadmap
- Gather user requirements and feedback
- Coordinate between stakeholders and development team
- Manage project timeline and milestones
- Ensure business requirements are met
- User documentation and marketing materials
success_criteria: Product Manager responsibilities are clearly documented
All 6 responsibility areas are defined
Documentation is sufficient for role hiring and evaluation
dependencies: Establish core project team structure

tasks.task_name: Create Product Manager MVP deliverables framework
tasks.description:
Establish the framework and templates for Product Manager MVP deliverables as specified in section 6.2.1. The Product Manager must deliver: user stories and acceptance criteria, MVP scope definition, user testing plan, and go-to-market strategy for CLI tool.

This task involves creating structured templates, processes, and documentation frameworks that the Product Manager will use to produce these deliverables. Each deliverable type should have clear formats, review processes, and quality standards.

The deliverables framework should support iterative development and enable clear communication between Product Manager, development team, and stakeholders.

parameters.project_context: CLI tool with Notion API integration

tasks.task_notes: These deliverables are critical for MVP success. The framework should be lightweight enough for rapid iteration but rigorous enough to ensure quality. Consider integrating with existing project management tools.

requirement_snippets:
**MVP Deliverables:**
- User stories and acceptance criteria
- MVP scope definition
- User testing plan
- Go-to-market strategy for CLI tool
constraints: Deliverables must be suitable for MVP phase
Must include go-to-market strategy specific to CLI tool
success_criteria: User stories and acceptance criteria templates are created
MVP scope definition framework is documented
User testing plan template is available
Go-to-market strategy template for CLI tool is defined
All deliverable frameworks are reviewed and approved
dependencies: Define Product Manager role responsibilities and scope

tasks.task_name: Define Technical Lead role responsibilities and scope
tasks.description:
Document the Technical Lead role as specified in section 6.2.2 of the requirement specification. The Technical Lead is responsible for architecture design and technical decisions, code review and quality standards, implementation of core modules, integration with Notion API, performance and security oversight, and mentoring other developers.

This task ensures the Technical Lead role has clear technical accountability and leadership expectations. The role encompasses both hands-on implementation work (core modules, Notion API integration) and leadership activities (code review, mentoring, architecture decisions).

The documentation should clarify decision-making authority, quality standards, and the balance between implementation and leadership responsibilities.

parameters.technical_context: Notion API integration, CLI tool development

tasks.task_notes: The Technical Lead role is critical for maintaining code quality and architectural consistency. Consider defining specific technical decision-making frameworks and code review checklists as part of this documentation.

requirement_snippets:
#### **6.2.2 Technical Lead**
**Responsibilities:**
- Architecture design and technical decisions
- Code review and quality standards
- Implementation of core modules
- Integration with Notion API
- Performance and security oversight
- Mentoring other developers
constraints: Must cover both implementation and leadership responsibilities
Must include Notion API integration as a specific responsibility
success_criteria: Technical Lead responsibilities are clearly documented
All 6 responsibility areas are defined
Technical decision-making authority is clarified
Code review and quality standards processes are outlined
Documentation is sufficient for role hiring and evaluation
dependencies: Establish core project team structure

tasks.task_name: Establish architecture design and technical decision framework
tasks.description:
Create the architecture design documentation and technical decision-making framework as required by the Technical Lead responsibilities in section 6.2.2. This includes defining the overall system architecture for the CLI tool with Notion API integration, establishing patterns and standards for technical decisions, and creating a decision log framework.

The architecture should address the key technical concerns: CLI interface design, Notion API client integration, data flow, error handling, configuration management, and extensibility.

The technical decision framework should define how architectural decisions are proposed, reviewed, documented, and communicated to the team.

parameters.architecture_scope: CLI tool with Notion API integration

tasks.task_notes: This is a high-priority task that enables other development work. The architecture should be documented early to guide implementation by Backend/CLI Developers. Consider creating Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) as part of this framework.

constraints: Must address Notion API integration requirements
Must support CLI tool implementation
Must include performance and security considerations
success_criteria: System architecture is documented and reviewed
Technical decision-making process is defined
Architecture addresses all key technical concerns (CLI, Notion API, core modules, performance, security)
Architecture documentation is accessible to all team members
dependencies: Define Technical Lead role responsibilities and scope
Establish core project team structure

tasks.task_name: Implement code review and quality standards process
tasks.description:
Establish code review processes and quality standards as required by the Technical Lead responsibilities in section 6.2.2. This includes defining code review workflows, quality gates, coding standards, testing requirements, and documentation standards.

The process should ensure consistent code quality across the team while supporting efficient development velocity. It should define what gets reviewed, who reviews, review criteria, and how feedback is incorporated.

Quality standards should cover code style, testing coverage, documentation requirements, security practices, and performance benchmarks relevant to CLI tool development and Notion API integration.
tasks.task_notes: Consider using automated tools (linters, formatters, CI/CD checks) to enforce standards consistently. The process should be documented and accessible to all developers.

success_criteria: Code review process is documented and communicated
Quality standards are defined for code style, testing, documentation, security, and performance
All team members understand and can follow the process
Quality gates are integrated into development workflow
dependencies: Define Technical Lead role responsibilities and scope
Establish architecture design and technical decision framework

tasks.task_name: Create user stories and acceptance criteria for MVP
tasks.description:
Develop comprehensive user stories and acceptance criteria as specified in Product Manager MVP deliverables (section 6.2.1). This deliverable defines the functional requirements from the user perspective and establishes clear acceptance criteria for each feature.

User stories should follow standard format (As a [user], I want [goal], so that [benefit]) and cover all MVP functionality for the CLI tool. Acceptance criteria should be specific, measurable, and testable.

This deliverable serves as the primary requirements documentation for the development team and the basis for QA testing plans.

parameters.format: Standard user story format with acceptance criteria

tasks.task_notes: This is a high-priority deliverable that gates development work. Should be created early and refined iteratively. Consider using a tool like Jira, Linear, or GitHub Issues to manage user stories.

requirement_snippets:
**MVP Deliverables:**
- User stories and acceptance criteria
constraints: Must be suitable for MVP phase
Must be specific to CLI tool
success_criteria: All MVP features have corresponding user stories
Each user story has clear, testable acceptance criteria
User stories are reviewed and approved by stakeholders
Stories are prioritized and ready for development
dependencies: Define Product Manager role responsibilities and scope
Establish core project team structure

tasks.task_name: Define MVP scope for CLI tool
tasks.description:
Create detailed MVP scope definition as specified in Product Manager MVP deliverables (section 6.2.1). This deliverable establishes the boundaries of the minimum viable product, identifying what features are in-scope and out-of-scope for the initial release.

The scope definition should balance user value delivery with development feasibility, focusing on core CLI functionality and essential Notion API integration features. It should clearly articulate the MVP vision and success metrics.

This document serves as the north star for the development team and helps prevent scope creep during MVP development.

parameters.project_context: CLI tool with Notion API integration

tasks.task_notes: Critical for aligning team expectations and preventing over-engineering. Should be finalized early and used as a reference throughout development. Changes to scope should be formally documented.

constraints: Must be focused on MVP (minimum viable product)
Must be specific to CLI tool functionality
success_criteria: MVP scope is clearly documented with in-scope and out-of-scope features
Success metrics for MVP are defined
Scope is reviewed and approved by stakeholders
Scope serves as effective guide for development prioritization
dependencies: Define Product Manager role responsibilities and scope
Create user stories and acceptance criteria for MVP

tasks.task_name: Develop user testing plan for MVP
tasks.description:
Create comprehensive user testing plan as specified in Product Manager MVP deliverables (section 6.2.1). This plan defines how the MVP CLI tool will be validated with real users, including test participant selection, test scenarios, success metrics, and feedback collection mechanisms.

The testing plan should cover usability testing, functional validation, and user satisfaction assessment. It should define test cases that map to user stories and acceptance criteria.

This deliverable ensures the MVP is validated against user needs before wider release and provides structured feedback for post-MVP iterations.
tasks.task_notes: Testing should be planned early but can be executed closer to MVP completion. Consider both internal (team) and external (end-user) testing phases.

constraints: Must be designed for MVP phase
Must validate CLI tool usability and functionality
success_criteria: User testing plan is documented with all key components
Test scenarios map to user stories and acceptance criteria
Success metrics are defined and measurable
Plan includes both usability and functional testing
Feedback collection and analysis process is defined
dependencies: Create user stories and acceptance criteria for MVP
Define MVP scope for CLI tool

tasks.task_name: Create go-to-market strategy for CLI tool
tasks.description:
Develop go-to-market strategy as specified in Product Manager MVP deliverables (section 6.2.1). This strategy defines how the CLI tool will be launched, marketed, and distributed to users, including target audience identification, distribution channels, messaging, launch timeline, and success metrics.

The strategy should be tailored specifically for CLI tool distribution, considering typical CLI tool adoption patterns (package managers, GitHub releases, documentation sites, developer communities).

This deliverable ensures a successful launch and provides a foundation for user acquisition and retention strategies.
tasks.task_notes: This strategy should be developed in parallel with product development but finalized before launch. Consider developer community channels (Reddit, Hacker News, Product Hunt) for CLI tool promotion.

requirement_snippets:
**MVP Deliverables:**
- Go-to-market strategy for CLI tool
constraints: Must be specific to CLI tool distribution and adoption
Must be executable for MVP launch
success_criteria: Go-to-market strategy is documented with all key components
Target audience is clearly defined
Distribution channels are identified and evaluated
Launch timeline is realistic and coordinated with development
Success metrics are defined and measurable
Strategy is reviewed and approved by stakeholders
dependencies: Define MVP scope for CLI tool
Create user stories and acceptance criteria for MVP

tasks.description:
Design and implement the Notion API integration framework as required by the Technical Lead responsibilities (section 6.2.2). This includes creating API client abstraction, authentication handling, request/response processing, error handling, rate limiting, and retry logic.

The integration framework should provide a clean, maintainable interface for other modules to interact with Notion API without directly managing API complexity. It should handle all Notion API-specific concerns (authentication, pagination, rate limits, versioning).

This is a core technical deliverable that enables all Notion-related functionality in the CLI tool.
tasks.task_notes: This is a critical technical foundation. The Technical Lead should implement or closely oversee this work. Consider using official Notion SDK if available, or building a custom client if needed. Must include comprehensive error handling for API failures.

constraints: Must integrate with Notion API
Must be implemented as part of Technical Lead deliverables
success_criteria: Notion API client is implemented and tested
Authentication flow is working correctly
Error handling covers all common API failure scenarios
Rate limiting prevents API quota violations
Integration is documented for other developers
Code passes review and meets quality standards
dependencies: Establish architecture design and technical decision framework
Define Technical Lead role responsibilities and scope

tasks.task_name: Establish performance and security oversight processes
tasks.description:
Create performance and security oversight processes and standards as required by the Technical Lead responsibilities (section 6.2.2). This includes defining performance benchmarks for the CLI tool, establishing security review checklists, implementing monitoring and profiling frameworks, and creating security testing procedures.

Performance oversight should ensure the CLI tool is responsive and efficient, particularly when interacting with Notion API. Security oversight should address authentication security, data handling, credential management, and dependency security.

These processes should be integrated into the development workflow and code review process.

parameters.tool_context: CLI tool with Notion API integration

tasks.task_notes: Performance and security should be integrated early rather than added later. Consider using automated tools for security scanning and performance profiling. Documentation should include runbooks for common security and performance issues.

constraints: Must cover both performance and security concerns
Must be applicable to CLI tool and Notion API integration
success_criteria: Performance benchmarks are defined for CLI operations
Security review checklist is created and integrated into code review
Automated security scanning is configured
Performance monitoring framework is implemented
Security best practices are documented
Processes are reviewed and approved by Technical Lead
dependencies: Establish architecture design and technical decision framework
Implement code review and quality standards process

tasks.task_name: Create developer mentoring and knowledge sharing program
tasks.description:
Establish developer mentoring and knowledge sharing program as required by the Technical Lead responsibilities (section 6.2.2). This includes creating mentoring frameworks, documentation practices, code review as learning opportunity, technical training sessions, and knowledge base development.

The program should support Backend/CLI Developers in learning the codebase, understanding architectural decisions, and developing their technical skills. It should foster a collaborative learning environment.

Special focus should be given to knowledge sharing around Notion API integration, CLI development best practices, and project-specific architectural patterns.
tasks.task_notes: This program supports team growth and code quality. Should be established early but can be refined iteratively. Consider 1-on-1 mentoring sessions, group code walkthroughs, and maintaining architectural decision records (ADRs).

constraints: Must support developer growth and knowledge sharing
Must be led by Technical Lead
success_criteria: Mentoring framework is documented
Knowledge sharing practices are established and followed
Technical documentation is comprehensive and accessible
Developers report improved understanding of codebase and architecture
Code review process includes educational feedback
dependencies: Define Technical Lead role responsibilities and scope
Implement code review and quality standards process

tasks.task_name: Establish stakeholder coordination and communication framework
tasks.description:
Create stakeholder coordination and communication framework as specified in Product Manager responsibilities (section 6.2.1). This includes identifying stakeholders, defining communication channels, establishing regular sync meetings, creating status reporting mechanisms, and ensuring alignment between stakeholders and development team.

The framework should facilitate efficient information flow between business stakeholders, Product Manager, and the technical team. It should define escalation paths, decision-making processes, and feedback loops.

Effective coordination is critical for ensuring business requirements are properly translated into technical implementation.
tasks.task_notes: This framework supports the Product Manager's coordination responsibility. Should be established early to ensure smooth project execution. Consider using tools like Slack channels, regular standups, and project management dashboards.

requirement_snippets:
**Responsibilities:**
- Coordinate between stakeholders and development team
constraints: Must connect stakeholders with development team
Must support two-way communication (requirements in, feedback out)
success_criteria: All stakeholders are identified and documented
Communication channels are established and active
Regular coordination meetings are scheduled
Status reporting mechanism is in place
Stakeholders and development team report good alignment
dependencies: Define Product Manager role responsibilities and scope
Establish core project team structure

tasks.task_name: Define project timeline and milestone tracking system
tasks.description:
Establish project timeline and milestone tracking system as specified in Product Manager responsibilities (section 6.2.1). This includes defining key project milestones, estimating deliverable timelines, creating tracking mechanisms, and establishing regular review cadence.

The system should provide visibility into project progress, identify risks and blockers early, and enable proactive timeline management. Milestones should align with MVP deliverables and technical implementation phases.

This system supports the Product Manager's responsibility to manage project timeline and ensure on-time delivery.
tasks.task_notes: Timeline management is critical for MVP delivery. Should be established early and updated regularly. Consider using project management tools (Jira, Linear, GitHub Projects) for tracking.

constraints: Must track progress toward MVP delivery
Must be managed by Product Manager
success_criteria: Project milestones are defined and documented
Timeline tracking system is operational
All team members can view project progress
Milestone reviews occur regularly
Timeline risks are identified and addressed proactively

Create user stories and acceptance criteria for MVP

tasks.task_name: Create user documentation and marketing materials
tasks.description:
Develop user documentation and marketing materials as specified in Product Manager responsibilities (section 6.2.1). This includes creating user guides, CLI command reference, installation instructions, quickstart tutorials, troubleshooting documentation, and promotional materials (website, demo videos, blog posts).

Documentation should be clear, comprehensive, and accessible to the target CLI tool user base. Marketing materials should effectively communicate the value proposition and encourage adoption.

These materials are essential for user onboarding and product adoption success.

deliverable_components: User guide and CLI command reference

tasks.task_notes: Documentation and marketing materials should be developed in parallel with product development and finalized before launch. Consider using tools like README.md, documentation generators (MkDocs, Docusaurus), and video recording tools.

constraints: Must include both user documentation and marketing materials
Must be suitable for CLI tool users
success_criteria: Comprehensive user documentation is created covering all CLI commands
Installation and setup instructions are clear and tested
Quickstart tutorial enables users to get started quickly
Marketing materials effectively communicate product value
Documentation and materials are reviewed for accuracy and clarity
All materials are ready for MVP launch
